control_objective: Security measures for personal information are selected and reviewed using documented risk context and accountability.
population: Quarterly security/privacy risk reviews in assessment period (2)
sampling_rationale: Full population due to small population and governance significance.

control_objective: Privileged access to systems processing personal information uses strong authentication and controlled exceptions commensurate with risk.
sampling_rationale: Full population because privileged identities are small, high impact and system-export testing was feasible.
conclusion: Partial - legacy access path bypassed MFA for 3 privileged identities.

control_objective: Access to personal-data systems is provisioned and removed through controlled lifecycle workflows.
population: 68 leavers and 31 role changes in Q2 2026
sampling_rationale: Judgemental sample includes high-privilege and customer-data application access across three months.
conclusion: Effective - sampled access removals/changes evidenced and timely.

control_objective: Personal information is protected in transit and at rest using risk-appropriate cryptographic safeguards.
sampling_rationale: Full population for selected critical processing paths.
conclusion: Effective for selected paths; no unsupported plaintext storage path identified.

control_objective: Controls reduce unauthorised disclosure of restricted personal information through managed endpoints and collaboration services.
population: 12 high-risk DLP policy rules; 37 triggered incidents in assessment period
sampling_rationale: Configuration full-population plus judgemental incident sample weighted to highest severity.
conclusion: Effective - sampled incidents were triaged and policy configuration matched approved standard.

control_objective: Known technical vulnerabilities affecting systems processing personal information are identified and remediated within risk-based timelines.
population: 27 Critical/High vulnerabilities on selected personal-data assets during July 2026
sampling_rationale: Full population of highest severity vulnerabilities to avoid understating aged exposure.
conclusion: Partial - 10 items exceeded approved remediation windows, including 4 Critical.

control_objective: Security-relevant activity from critical personal-data systems is available for timely detection and investigation.
sampling_rationale: Full population because source coverage can be reconciled directly to the critical-system inventory.
conclusion: Partial - 2 critical sources lacked central ingestion/alert coverage.

control_objective: Systems processing personal information have resilience measures proportionate to service and data criticality.
population: 4 critical processing services in selected scope
sampling_rationale: Full population for selected critical services.
conclusion: Effective - redundancy and recovery design were documented for selected services.

control_objective: MTFS can restore availability and access to personal information following an incident within defined recovery objectives.
population: 8 protected backup sets for selected critical systems
sample: 4 backup sets including core banking, CRM, privacy case management and identity configuration
sampling_rationale: Judgemental sample prioritises highest customer/privacy impact and different recovery technologies.
conclusion: Partial - one critical core-banking restore had no completed annual restore-test evidence.

control_objective: Security controls are regularly tested, assessed and tracked to remediation.
population: 6 scheduled security-control assurance activities in H1 2026
sampling_rationale: Full population due to small governance population.
conclusion: Effective - testing schedule and issue tracking were evidenced.

framework_reference: UK GDPR Articles 32, 33; Article 34 considered where high risk
control_objective: Potential personal-data breaches are identified, assessed, escalated and capable of notification without undue delay and within applicable statutory timeframes.
population: 1 tabletop plus 9 synthetic privacy incidents in Q2 sample register
sampling_rationale: Tabletop exercises end-to-end readiness; record sample covers different severity/notification outcomes.
conclusion: Effective - tabletop reached a reasoned reportability decision and prepared notification within 26 hours of awareness.

control_objective: Material processors provide sufficient security guarantees, contracts include required security obligations, and assurance is refreshed proportionate to risk.
population: 5 material processors in selected ROPA activities
sampling_rationale: Judgemental sample covers critical cloud, privacy workflow and customer CRM processing.
conclusion: Partial - Northbridge annual security assurance was overdue and an earlier penetration-test action lacked closure evidence.
